description: Guest asks to cancel 10 days before check-in, booked 5 days ago. Should trigger 50% refund rule per policy. No prior host statements on cancellation.
guestMessage: Hi, we need to cancel our reservation for next week due to a change in plans. What is the refund situation?
notes: Classic mid-window cancellation. Old code + prompt must give precise 50% explanation + official link + tell guest they must cancel themselves on Airbnb.
